nightBeginsSoon: Night phase begins in a moment…
quietNight: A quiet night — no one died.
pickTargetConfirmOrSkip: Pick a target, then confirm — or skip.
pickTargetsConfirmOrSkip: Pick your targets, then confirm — or skip.
dayBreaks: Day breaks. The villagers gather to speak and to vote.
hasBeenBanished: has been banished from the village.
drawNoOneBanished: The vote was a draw — no one banished.
notEnoughVotes: Not enough votes — no one banished.
WerewolfDescriptionLong: A werewolf with no special ability. Each night you and other werewolves select a target to attack. Your goal is to devour most of the villagers and not get caught.
WerewolfDescriptionShort: Devour villagers and don't get caught.
DraculaDescriptionLong: Each night you can cast a shadow upon a player of your choice. This player may not be banished the next day.
DraculaDescriptionShort: You can protect a player from being banished.
DeceiverDescriptionLong: Each night you can select a player. If that player is entitled to a clue for their role, that clue will contain a misleading lie.
GhostDescriptionLong: You are undetectable - for any villager ability, whether passive or active, you appear as a regular villager.
GhostDescriptionShort: You are undetectable by any villager ability.
CharmerDescriptionLong: You can select a player to make them fall asleep. In result their night ability, either passive or active, will not work.
ChamerDescriptionShort: You can make a player fall asleep, disabling their night ability.
VillagerDescriptionLong: A villager with no special ability. Your goal is to find the werewolves and banish them from the village.
VillagerDescriptionShort: Find the werewolves and banish them.
GuardianDescriptionLong: Each night you can protect a player. The protected player will be immune to any werewolf attacks.
GuardianDescriptionShort: You can protect a player from werewolf attacks.
DetectiveDescriptionLong: Each night you will be told the identity of a random villager.
DetectiveDescriptionShort: Each night you learn the identity of a random villager.
DogTamerDescriptionLong: You've tamed a dog that is able to detect werewolves nearby. If there are exactly {{numWerewolves}} among {{rangeDoubled}} closest players the dog will bark. If there are too many or too few werewolves, it will stay quiet.
DogTamerDescriptionShort: Each night your dog barks if there are exactly {{numWerewolves}} werewolves among {{rangeDoubled}} closest players.
SeerDescriptionLong: Each night you can select two players (except yourself). Then you will be told whether those players are in the same team.
SeerDescriptionShort: You can learn whether two players are on the same team.
TrailerDescriptionLong: Each night you will be told the direction to the nearest werewolf. If the distances are equal, you will be told a random direction
TrailerDescriptionShort: Each night you learn the direction to the nearest werewolf.
PoacherDescriptionLong: Each night you can set a trap on a player. If that player is attacked by a werewolf, the trap will trigger and one of the werewolves will die too.
PoacherDescriptionShort: Set a trap on a player. If they are attacked, a werewolf dies too.
PeeperDescriptionLong: Each night you will be told whether a selected player is a villager or not. However, if they are a werewolf, you will die of fright!
PeeperDescriptionShort: You can check if a player is a villager, but beware of werewolves!
SpyDescriptionLong: Each night you will be told whether a selected player has targetted anyone.
SpyDescriptionShort: Check if a player has left their house at night.
RangerDescriptionLong: Every night, you can set a tripwire between two players. You will learn how many players crossed that path during the night.
RangerDescriptionShort: Set a tripwire between two players to count how many crossed it overnight.
AlchemistDescriptionLong: You're brewing a potion. The longer you wait with drinking it the better clue you will obtain. The best possible reward is available since night 5. The clue will refer to the roles in current game.
AlchemistDescriptionShort: Wait with drinking your potion to get a better clue about the roles in the game.
SorcererDescriptionLong: Once per game, you can perform a ritual on any group of players you choose, revealing how many of them are werewolves.
SorcererDescriptionShort: Discover how many werewolves there are among the selected group of players.
InnkeeperDescriptionLong: Each night you may drink a few cold ones with a player. If that player is killed by werewolves the following night, you will be told a list of players smelling of alcohol - one of them is the killer.
InnkeeperDescriptionShort: You can smell alcohol from a group of players. One of them must be a werewolf!
FoolDescriptionLong: You pose as a villager, but you secretly want to be banished. If you are banished, you win the game.
FoolDescriptionShort: Convince the villagers to banish you.
trailerClueLong: Trailer clue: the nearest werewolf is to the {{dir}}.
rangerClueLong: Ranger clue - the tripwire was activated {{times}} times.
alchemistClue1: Alchemist clue 1/5 - there are {{num}} roles with an active ability this game.
alchemistClue2: Alchemist clue 2/5 - villager role pool (including potential alibis) is: {{pool}}.
alchemistClue3: Alchemist clue 3/5 - villager and neutral role pool (including potential alibis) is: {{pool}}.
alchemistClue4: Alchemist clue 4/5 - werewolf role pool is: {{pool}}.
sorcererClueLong: Sorcerer clue - there are {{count}} werewolves among your selected players.
innkeeperClueLong: Innkeeper clue — these players smell of alcohol: {{list}}.
poacherTriggered: Trap triggered! A werewolf also died (target: {{target}}).
dogTamerNumWerewolves: Werewolves for the dog to bark
villageOfSecrets: A party game based on bluffing and deduction
tagline: Trust no one. Vote wisely. Survive till dawn.
noPlayersYet: No players yet — invite some travelers.
landingLede: An iconic social game set in a village plagued by werewolves. Everyone sits at one table but you never know who's who. Talk, deduce, and don't be fooled.
step1Body: One player creates a lobby and shares the six-letter code. Everyone else joins with it — no accounts, no installs.
step2Body: Roles and teams are assigned in secret: obtain a clue, protect someone or sow the seeds of doubt. Only you can see your role. You can share it but no one has to believe you.
step3Body: Turn by turn the village acts in the dark. Werewolves choose a victim; guardian shields, detective pries, trailer looks for tracks.
step4Body: The survivors compare stories and vote to banish one suspect. The game goes on until one side is left standing.
townGoal: Find and banish every werewolf before the village is emptied.
wolfGoal: Devour the villagers, blend in by day, and never get caught.
landingFoot: Best played IRL or over a voice call. Pick a name above and create a lobby.
nicknameHint: Used as your default name at the table.
guestHint: You're playing as a guest — link an account to keep your stats and history.
noGames: No games yet — open a table and play your first round.
youAreWatching: You are watching the rest of the game — you can no longer act or vote.
waitForRematch: Waiting for host to create rematch...
drunkPresent: A Drunk is in this game...
